stdout:
Local storage service, setup, administration and offline rescue

Usage: zxs [OPTIONS] <COMMAND>

Commands:
  config-template          Produce a configuration draft without accessing or initializing any device
  init                     Explicitly initialize a new pool. Development disks simulate independent devices
  init-auth                Initialize credentials for an existing local pool that has no credential store
  register-disk            Add a disk to an uninitialized JSON configuration draft. Does not migrate a live pool
  serve                    
  restore-system           
  recovery-preview         Inspect an already decided, unpublished operation using all original members
  recovery-commit          Publish only the previously reviewed recovery plan after explicit loss acknowledgement
  offline-check            
  offline-export           
  export-history           Export a complete independently verifiable history package. Destination must not exist; its parent must be owned by this user and mode 0700
  check-history-package    
  restore-history-package  
  account                  Add or revoke an account locally; changing grants revokes all of its existing sessions
  create-repo              
  smb-binding              
  policy                   
  rule                     
  repositories             
  disks                    
  topology                 
  list                     
  history                  
  graph                    
  branch                   
  link                     
  namespace                
  purge                    
  split                    
  historical-save          
  plan-commit              
  plan-cancel              
  operation                
  check                    
  help                     Print this message or the help of the given subcommand(s)

Options:
      --root <ROOT>            [default: ./zxs-data]
      --principal <PRINCIPAL>  [default: admin]
  -h, --help                   Print help
  -V, --version                Print version

Service/setup: config-template, init, init-auth, register-disk, serve.
Offline rescue: restore-system, recovery-preview, recovery-commit, offline-check, offline-export, export-history, check-history-package, restore-history-package.
Other commands are local administration; stop the service before opening its pool.
No remote client or ordinary file transfer commands. Use SMB for file contents.
